raw.answer: The corpus does not contain a GR dated 19/01/2018. product.answer: No newer GR found in this corpus directly changes the State cloud policy dated 19/01/2018, but the 23-04-2021 GR (M/s 2021/3/060) replaced the earlier cloud empanelment and rate structure with GeM portal procurement, ending the 3-year empanelment on 30-04-2021. Earlier, the 29-01-2018 GR (060/3/2017) issued the original Cloud Computing Policy, and the 16-05-2018 GR (060/3/2017/1) detailed CSP empanelment and rates until 30-04-2020, later amended by the 04-08-2018 and 19-05-2018 GRs.
